narrative_shape: A verification-focused retry: by T75 it is almost all Bash (70) with 2 reads, 2 writes, and effectively no edits. Visible turns are launching and waiting on long full-disc checks: identity at -j1/-j4 and round-trip (T68-71), compare_disc (T83-89), and then a ~5 minute coord_scale check with repeated 'I'll wait' turns (T98-116). The check passes (0 of 1,461,347 exceeding, T118) and it commits (T119). Waiting is the dominant activity, but it terminates cleanly.

rationale: Wait-dominated verification from the first visible turn, with repeated 'I'll wait' statements around the long coord_scale check. It ends in a pass and commit, so the polling is cost rather than failure. Distinct from build shapes.
